## 提交检查 / Checklist

- [ ] 基于最新 main / Based on current main
- [ ] 改动范围单一且原因清楚 / Focused scope and clear rationale
- [ ] 已填写实际验证结果 / Actual validation results included
- [ ] 不包含密钥、个人数据、小说内容、日志或构建产物 / No secrets, private data, novel content, logs or build output
